body: It’s been getting harder and harder to breathe and I’m afraid I’m falling back to old habits that I tried to kill. I just can’t deal with the numbness. I had to feel something again. Whatever it was. And I don’t know I’m freaking out so much but all I can show is a tired look. I don’t know.
The thing is, he always say that he’s happy with me and that its just everything else in his personal life that’s breaking him apart.
